datasheet_identity.title: INTERCONNECTS Series 800, 801, 830 surface mount headers and sockets, single row strips

extraction_notes: The supplied PDF is not a BSS138BKWT106 MOSFET datasheet. It identifies Mill-Max Mfg. Corp. interconnect headers and sockets, including Series 800, 801, and 830 mechanical drawings and ordering information.

No MOSFET electrical characteristics, polarity, threshold voltage, RDS(on), capacitances, breakdown voltage, or body-diode data are present in the supplied PDF. The required polarity field is set to n from the BSS138 part designation but is not verified by this mismatched source document.
The supplied PDF contains mechanical dimensional drawings only; no usable electrical curves can be extracted.
omission_reason: The supplied public PDF is an unrelated one-page Mill-Max interconnect mechanical drawing, not a BSS138BKWT106 MOSFET datasheet; all MOSFET extraction fields except the schema-required polarity placeholder are unavailable.
